name: Koke Garden
description: A quiet, organic and editorial business theme for a small Japanese garden design studio (two garden designers and a stone setter) that designs and keeps moss, stone and gravel gardens: courtyards, tea gardens, entrances, rooftops and riverbanks. Pale moss paper, sage stone, moss and deep moss ink, with raked-gravel line textures, line-drawn plan sketches and small stone-dot bullets. A quiet bar with only the wordmark and a Menu button opens a full-screen menu on pale moss paper with large Alegreya items and the studio details. The home page sets a short statement on a paper panel over a garden photo, then the projects as a mosaic of photo cards and moss, stone and gravel cards carrying plan sketches, the seasonal care plans, the approach in three lines and the journal. The footer is a book colophon: garden credits (plants, stone, gravel, typefaces), the studio details, a small menu and the copyright. With Projects (six project pages with brief, site, plants and stone, care plan, photos, plan sketch and next-garden link), Seasonal care (a five-season care calendar and the care plans), About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact (email enquiry, no backend, address without a map). The studio details and the care plans are synced patterns, edited once. Alegreya over Alegreya Sans. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

fonts.role: display: the wordmark, headings, the full-screen menu, prices, season names and the colophon credits
